settings.headline:

settings.copy: Verdant Trust buys, restores, and permanently protects wild land, clean water, and native habitat across the region — so the places we love stay wild for the people who come after us.

settings.title: Conservation that
settings.intro: We don't just hold land on paper. We restore it, steward it, and open it to the people who will care for it next.

features.title: Protect the land
features.text: We work with willing landowners to place conservation easements and buy critical parcels, locking in protection that survives every change of ownership.

features.title: Restore the habitat
features.text: Our crews replant native forest, reconnect floodplains, and remove invasive species so wildlife and clean water can return on their own.

features.title: Keep the water clean
features.text: Healthy forests and wetlands filter the water that feeds our rivers and wells. We protect the headwaters so the whole watershed stays drinkable.

features.title: Steward forever
features.text: Protection is a promise, not a one-time deed. We monitor every easement and parcel each year and act when a boundary or habitat needs care.

features.title: Open the trails
features.text: Protected land is public land. We build and maintain low-impact trails so families can walk the same woods we're working to save.

features.title: Grow the next stewards
features.text: School programs and volunteer days teach the next generation why wild places matter — and how to keep them wild.

settings.title: From first walk

steps.title: Walk the land
steps.text: A landowner reaches out, and we walk the property together — mapping the habitat, the water, and what makes the place worth saving.

steps.title: Assess the value
steps.text: Our ecologists and appraisers document the conservation value and the fair terms, so the deal is honest for the landowner and the trust.

steps.title: Protect it
steps.text: We place a conservation easement or acquire the parcel, recording the protection in the deed so it binds every future owner.

steps.title: Restore & steward
steps.text: We restore what's degraded, then monitor the land every year — walking the boundaries, checking the habitat, and keeping the promise alive.

steps.title: Open it up
steps.text: Where it's safe and appropriate, we build trails and host volunteer days, so the community can love the land and help protect it too.

settings.note: Most of our projects start with a single landowner who wants their family's land to stay wild after they're gone. We make that wish permanent.

settings.title: Give a place
settings.quote: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children. Every acre we hold is a debt we're proud to repay.

settings.title: Protected by people,
settings.intro: Landowners, volunteers, and neighbors on why they trust Verdant Trust with the places they love.

reviews.quote: My family farmed this valley for three generations. Placing the easement with Verdant was the hardest and best decision we made — the land stays open, and it stays ours to walk.
reviews.author: Harold B.

reviews.quote: I've volunteered on the river restoration every spring for five years. Watching the salmon come back to a creek that was nearly dead — that's why I keep coming.
reviews.author: Nadia K.

reviews.quote: The trails they built let my kids grow up in the same woods I did. Knowing it's protected forever means they'll get to show their own kids.
reviews.author: Tomás R.
